As of the [[2020 United States census]], the borough's population reached 25,326, its highest decennial count ever and an increase of 2,482 (+10.9%) from the [[2010 United States census|2010 census]] count of 22,844, which in turn reflected an increase of 2,135 (+10.3%) from the 20,709 counted in the [[2000 United States census|2000 census]].[https://www.nj.gov/labor/labormarketinformation/assets/PDFs/census/2010/2010data/table7cm.xls Table 7.
